english.title: Registered person contravene / fail to notify Department of Health of termination
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity consisting of the termination of pregnancies, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE NAME..), failed to ensure that notice in writing was sent to the Chief Medical Officer of the Department of Health and Social Care of each termination of pregnancy
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(9) and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulation 20(1) states the offence only applies to a person registered who is not an English NHS body.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant was a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity consisting of the termination of pregnancies, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE NAME..), failed to ensure that notice in writing was sent to the Chief Medical Officer of the Department of Health and Social Care of each termination of pregnancy.
